about: Wavehunters has run surf schools on the beach at Watergate Bay and Polzeath since 2002. As well as group and private lessons, it runs the Groms Surf Club for young surfers, surf hire, beach fitness and boat trips from Padstow, Rock and Port Isaac.
offers: Groms Surf Club for young surfers
where: On the beach at Watergate Bay and Polzeath
